printf '%s\n' 'import json, urllib.request, urllib.error, subprocess, sys, time' 'def get_key(ctid, cfg_path):' '    out = subprocess.check_output(["pct", "exec", str(ctid), "--", "cat", cfg_path], text=True)' '    return out.split("<ApiKey>")[1].split("<")[0]' 'def api(ctid, cfg_path, path, method="GET", body=None):' '    key = get_key(ctid, cfg_path)' '    req =
